items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I worked beside him for a long time when we played in Basie‘s band

ctx.x: I replaced Ed Lewis. I replaced Ed Lewis and the only way I replaced Ed Lewis, I think his age got him out of Count Basie‘s band. And Ed Lewis was a hell of a first trumpet player, but I worked beside him for a long time when we played in Basie‘s band and Ed Lewis was still in there, but I guess, knock on wood [knocks on wood], I guess I must have been lucky to replace Ed Lewis to take his place in that band, because that band that‘s when it got to be, how can I say? It put swing back into, not back into it, into…
